context: Request: M&A deals where the firm actually invoked or litigated specific performance, with the papers. Rubric: 1018-00008 (Penterra/Veridian), its draft-counterclaim-declaratory-judgment.docx and matter-status-memo-deal-terminated.docx (pre-litigation demand), plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Parallel whole-store glob and a files-with-matches grep for the request phrase; the grep returns one email.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Two batches of reads of agreements and memos of the matters at the top of the listing, plus the one grep hit (labelled by the dominant intent).

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for the request phrase; times out after about 120K chars.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of six candidate matters from the scan output.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the opening of one agreement from each of those matters.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Shell search of file paths for request words and deal-document names.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of six candidate matters picked from the file-name hits.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads four memos, a draft pleading and a notice of the matter it later picked and two documents of another candidate.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Snippet-extraction script over four named documents of two candidates.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes one matter with its papers.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: Search file contents for request keywords → Read documents picked from the file listing → Scan document text with an extraction script → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search file names for request keywords → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Found the matter and its draft pleading, but never opened the status memo that records the pre-litigation demand, although it was in the file listing.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: The matter's file listing included the status memo recording the counterparty's demand, but it chose other memos and pleadings to read and never opened or cited that memo.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus shell find (prints only the working folder).

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads pleadings, memos and agreements of the two matters at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for the request phrase; times out after about 314K chars.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists the subfolders of nine candidate matters named in the scan output.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Shell search of file paths for court-paper and dispute words, first 200 hits.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads briefs, complaints and memos of three matters from those hits.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide script for the request phrase limited by path words; times out after a few files.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads memos, a letter and a motion of five more candidates; one guessed path does not exist.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Lists all matter folder names.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Shell loop unzipping court-paper files and grepping for the request phrase; prints nothing.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Shell loop listing matters that have both deal documents and court-paper file names.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads a brief, memos and a letter of two candidates.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists files of two candidate matters.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Snippet-extraction script for the request phrase over three candidate matters.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes one deal (under two matter numbers) as the only qualifying one.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Scan document text with an extraction script → List files in candidate matters → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Search within a candidate matter's files → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Every scan and file-name filter missed the matter (timeouts, a loop that printed nothing); it named another deal instead.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Its store-wide extraction scan timed out before reaching the matter it needed; later scans and file-name filters also missed it (timeouts, a loop that printed nothing), and it never searched plain file names for the request phrase.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Two greps with single-extension globs; both return nothing.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads agreements and a memo of the matters at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for the request phrase and related remedy terms; times out after about 2.3M chars.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of one candidate matter.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Script listing docx files whose names contain request words or deal-document names.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of the one matter whose file names matched.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads six documents of that matter (memos, draft pleadings, notice, agreement).

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads four more memos and notices of that matter plus one filing of another matter.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes one matter with its papers.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Edits a caution section of the response.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file contents for request keywords → Read documents picked from the file listing → Scan document text with an extraction script → List files in candidate matters → Search file names for request keywords → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Found the matter and its draft pleading, but never opened the status memo that records the pre-litigation demand, although it was in the matter's file listing.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: The matter's file listing included the status memo recording the counterparty's demand, but across two batches of reads it chose other memos and never opened or cited that memo.

divergence: T0 and T2 failed the same way: they found the matter through a file-name search, listed its files, and read many of its documents, but never opened the one status memo a criterion requires (first error at the screening read right after the listing). T1 failed earlier: every scan and file-name filter missed the matter (search-miss at its first scan) and it named another deal.
